## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Establish which preview semantics match the pinned runtime and expose remaining limitations.

**Scope:** Independent native captures or verified renderer-reference comparison and versioned fidelity report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Compare transforms, ordering, alpha, timing and body/head anchors with independent captures or a verified renderer reference for Novice and Orc multipart actions.
- [x] Document exact comparison source/build/hash, tested behavior/action/view scope, differences and reproducible artifacts.
- [x] Absent or partial parity evidence keeps affected preview PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED; provisional art review never becomes verified visual-runtime acceptance.
- [x] Preview parity does not replace exact-action native evidence or operator aesthetic approval; relevant semantics changes invalidate the affected parity/review scope.

## Verification

Reproduce comparison captures/reference checks and inspect differences. Environment-blocked comparison is NOT_RUN with limitation; M2 native parity remains unresolved.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-13 (M2-03; task ID sr7zifcthz9m09btrmjlaosv)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No unconditional dependency on all of M0-N: a limited preview may ship visibly unverified; no full-parity claim until evidence.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.
